title: Preservation of Scripture
definition: The preservation of Scripture is God's faithful work of ensuring that His Word remains available, trustworthy, and accessible throughout history.
summary: God has faithfully preserved His Word so that future generations may know His truth.
christFocus: Jesus declared that God's Word would endure and remain trustworthy through every generation.
keyScriptures: <button type="button" class="doctrine-scripture-link cross-ref-link" data-ref="1 Peter 1:24-25" onclick="openDoctrineScriptureReference('1 Peter 1:24-25')">1 Peter 1:24-25</button>

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Throughout history, God has preserved His Word despite persecution, opposition, neglect, and attempts to destroy it. While copies and translations have been produced across centuries, the message of Scripture has been faithfully maintained.

The preservation of Scripture demonstrates God's faithfulness to His promises. Believers today can read, study, and trust the Bible with confidence because God has not allowed His revelation to disappear from the earth.

This doctrine strengthens confidence that God's truth remains available and effective for every generation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people wonder whether the Bible has been lost, corrupted, or changed beyond recognition. Understanding preservation helps believers trust that God has faithfully guarded His revealed truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Thank God for the access you have to His Word. Read it, treasure it, and share it with others, recognizing that countless believers throughout history longed for the access many enjoy today.
